definitions.explanation: A person who performs in plays, movies, television, or other dramatic productions.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{有名|ゆうめい}な{俳優|はいゆう}だ。
{俳優|はいゆう}を{目指|めざ}して{上京|じょうきょう}した。
examples.english: I came to Tokyo aspiring to be an actor.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}には{人気|にんき}{俳優|はいゆう}が{出演|しゅつえん}している。
examples.english: Popular actors appear in this movie.

notes:
USAGE: {俳優|はいゆう} is a gender-neutral term for actors. While it can technically refer to any performer, it's most commonly used for stage and screen actors.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{俳優|はいゆう}になる (to become an actor)
・{俳優|はいゆう}を{目指|めざ}す (to aspire to be an actor)
・{人気|にんき}{俳優|はいゆう} (popular actor)
・{性格|せいかく}{俳優|はいゆう} (character actor)
・{主演|しゅえん}{俳優|はいゆう} (lead actor)

RELATED WORDS:
・{女優|じょゆう} - actress (female specifically)
・{男優|だんゆう} - actor (male specifically) - less common
・{役者|やくしゃ} - actor (traditional/stage)
・{芸能人|げいのうじん} - entertainer (general)
・{タレント} - TV personality
